text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Would you like some black tea as well, Trainer?
The tea leaves are first flush Darjeeling.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It is rich in theanine, which is said to enhance focus.
It makes the perfect drink before a race.
choice_data_list: You seem to have plenty of leeway.
You seem to have plenty of leeway.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes, everything is in perfect order. Physical, mental, the analysis of the previous defeat, and the strategy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What I should do right now... is drink black tea.
I can't think of anything else to do, really.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...My victory is all but guaranteed, after all.
